_comment: Site-wide config, compiled into the bundle at build time. n8n_base is the host that serves the five quiz endpoints (/lead /slots /book /lead/skip /beacon) under api_prefix. Empty pixel_id keeps the Meta Pixel inert. Empty turnstile_sitekey keeps the Turnstile slot inert.
footer_line: SortMyCover is a service of Lead Velocity (Pty) Ltd. We introduce you to authorised financial services providers. We are not a financial services provider. We do not give financial advice, compare products or quote premiums. You must be 18 or older.

will_provider._comment: Wills and estate (theme B) pages: the provider of the will and estate service. Change it here only: {provider} in config/angles.json renders as name, and the lines below render on every theme B page, its FAQ and thank-you page. Every line is a statement the provider publishes; the evidence ids point to config/evidence.json and the watcher (scripts/check-capital-legacy.mjs, automation/W36.json) emails when a source page changes. A new provider needs new lines and new evidence, not just a new name.
will_provider.name: Capital Legacy
will_provider.service_line: The will and estate service on this page is provided by {legal_name}, {status} (FSP {fsp}).
will_provider.cost_line: {provider} says it does not charge to draft, update, store or retrieve a will. It also offers optional cover for the costs of winding up an estate, at a monthly cost, and its consultant explains the terms.
will_provider.role_line: SortMyCover does not draft wills and gives no advice. It puts you in touch with a {provider} consultant.
